orders.label: Follow
orders.meaning: Guard the commander; keep support behind the frontline.

orders.label: Attack
orders.meaning: Advance and engage nearby threats, or focus a selected enemy.

orders.label: Hold
orders.meaning: Defend the chosen anchor; pursue only within ten blocks.

orders.label: Charge
orders.meaning: Commit to a selected enemy with reduced cohesion.

orders.label: Retreat
orders.meaning: Disengage to the destination; ignore enemies and interrupt prior attacks.

formations.label: Compact
formations.purpose: Narrow frontage; infantry screen the rear.

formations.label: Line
formations.purpose: Wide firing frontage; needs open ground.

formations.label: Shieldwall
formations.purpose: Wide shield front; shield troops brace when enemies close.

modes.name: Domination
modes.howTo: Send troops onto a point to take it; hold it to score. | Reach the target score first, or lead when time ends.
modes.howToDefend: Send troops onto a point to take it; hold it to score. | Reach the target score first, or lead when time ends.

modes.name: Siege
modes.howTo: Break the gate; siege troops strike it four times harder. | Seize the keep before the clock runs out.
modes.howToDefend: Hold the yard, then the gate, then the keep. | When the clock runs out, Ironhold is yours.

modes.name: Convoy
modes.howTo: Stay by the wagon to push it; an enemy beside it stops it. | Reach the refuge before the clock runs out.
modes.howToDefend: Stand by the wagon to stop it. | Hold it until the clock runs out.

modes.name: Survival
modes.howTo: Hold the shrine against every wave; clear a wave for its gold. | Lose the shrine for 20 seconds and the night is lost.
modes.howToDefend: Hold the shrine against every wave; clear a wave for its gold. | Lose the shrine for 20 seconds and the night is lost.

campaignBattles.name: The Training Field
campaignBattles.briefing: Dusk raiders hold the river road. Take the crossings and teach your banner to follow you.
campaignBattles.reason: The road west must open before the march begins.

campaignBattles.name: The Iron Gate
campaignBattles.briefing: The Ironclad hold their gate and will not open it. Break it with the engines, then take the keep behind it.
campaignBattles.reason: The march cannot go north past a shut iron gate.
campaignBattles.placeholder: briefing,reason (draft text 2026-11-02 for Kort to edit, Q74)

campaignBattles.name: The Long Night
campaignBattles.briefing: The graves of Hollowwood are opening under the moon. Hold the shrine and keep your banner standing until the dead lie still.
campaignBattles.reason: The march must camp at the shrine tonight, and so must the dead.
campaignBattles.placeholder: briefing,reason (draft text 2026-11-02 for Kort to edit, Q74)

campaignBattles.name: The Frozen Standard
campaignBattles.briefing: The Wildmoot hunt the pass and the wagon with our standard must cross it. Walk beside it and do not let it be stopped.
campaignBattles.reason: Without its standard the march is only a crowd of armed men.
campaignBattles.placeholder: briefing,reason (draft text 2026-11-02 for Kort to edit, Q74); Kort 2026-10-31: a convoy escort; mode and bonus set by the approved convoy spec

campaignBattles.name: The Five Crossings
campaignBattles.briefing: Tidecaller raiders have come up out of the water to take Kingsfield. Hold the fords and bridges, and strike where they are thin.
campaignBattles.reason: Kingsfield is where every road meets, and the march needs them.
campaignBattles.placeholder: briefing,reason (draft text 2026-11-02 for Kort to edit, Q74)

campaignBattles.name: The Last Watch
campaignBattles.briefing: The Hollow King has taken the keep at Ironhold. The Houses you met stand with you now. Break his gate and strike him down yourself.
campaignBattles.reason: The king in the keep ends the march, or the march ends.
campaignBattles.placeholder: briefing,reason (draft text 2026-11-02 for Kort to edit, Q74); Kort 2026-11-02 (Q76, Q77): Siege with allied bot banners from all five Houses; hard, the top tier, with the allies one tier below so the enemy outclasses your side
